1.why: Text uses a clean sans-serif with comfortable line height, but letter spacing looks close to default rather than deliberately generous.

2.why: No italics, all-caps strings, or dense paragraphs appear on any screen; headings, labels, and buttons are short title-case text.

3.why: The narrow single-column layout with large text and full-width buttons reads cleanly at the mobile width shown in all five screenshots.

4.why: Instructions such as 'Start your security setup.' and 'There is no reading timer. Take as long as you need.' are single short plain-language sentences.

5.why: Placeholder examples 'name@example.com' and '123456' show the expected format for the email and six-digit code inputs.

6.why: Every screen contains only brief sentences and short status banners, so no long block of text must be read to proceed.

7.why: No copy-to-clipboard control is offered and the code must be keyed by hand; the only source is the browser console, which is unrealistic to copy from on a phone.

8.why: No QR code or equivalent alternative to manual entry appears on any of the five screens.

9.why: Standard labeled email/password fields should work with password managers, but nothing on the code screen indicates one-time-code autofill support and input attributes cannot be verified from screenshots.

10.why: Icon-plus-heading and one solid blue button make each screen's purpose and primary action clear, though the four-segment progress bar stays at one filled segment between requesting and entering the code.

11.why: Each screen has a single solid primary button, but the equally large outlined 'Re-request identity code' button adds a second prominent action on the code screen.

12.why: Green status banners plainly state what happened and what comes next ('Signed in successfully. Next: get your identity code.'), echoed by the activity log.

13.why: The 'Re-request identity code' button and the ability to resubmit after an error allow retry without any shown penalty, though no reveal/hide toggle exists (the code is entered as visible text).

14.why: The error 'That code does not match. Check the six digits, or request a new code.' states the problem and the fix without blaming the user.

15.why: The flow explicitly states 'There is no reading timer. Take as long as you need.' and no countdown or expiry warning appears on any screen.
